metadata.method: 2D scalar 5-point cell-centered finite difference; subcell area-averaged n^2; sparse symmetric shift-invert eigenproblem
metadata.boundary: u=0 at x,y=±domain halfwidth; odd ghost values at boundary faces
metadata.polarization: none; scalar fundamental u00, not TE/TM or quasi-TE
metadata.limits: Scalar approximation omits vector/interface conditions; especially inaccurate for high-contrast silicon. Converging scalar discretization does not validate actual strip neff, polarization, loss or power.
metadata.display: 101×101 samples over ±1 µm; interpolated from the solved grid for display, common 0–1 relative squared-field scale
